title: Server admin
subtitle: Everyone on this server: users, organizations, quotas, custom images, usage and the runners doing the work.
notAdmin: Only server admins can open this page. Add your email to HEIMDALL_SERVER_ADMINS on the server, restart it and sign in again.
localMode: The server admin page is for hosted servers. A local bench has one organization and no quotas.

overview.stubQuota: Quotas are not saved: this server uses the in-memory quota store, so edits are lost on restart. Enable the Postgres quota store (shared pool) to keep them.

kill.title: Kill switch
kill.on: On: runners lease no new runs. Runs already started finish.
kill.confirmOn: Stop every organization from starting new runs? Runs in progress keep going.

users.empty: No users yet. The first sign-up creates the owner.
users.name: Name
users.confirmDisable: Disable {{email}}? They are signed out and can not sign in until enabled again.

orgs.empty: No organizations yet. Each sign-up creates one.
orgs.name: Name
orgs.quotaSummary: {{concurrent}} at once, {{perDay}} a day, ${{spend}} a day

images.empty: No custom image requests. Orgs ask for one from their settings when their quota allows custom images.
images.unavailable: Image approval is not available on this server yet (the shared pool area is not enabled).
images.rejectReason: Why is this image rejected? (shown to the org)

usage.unavailable: Platform usage is not available on this server yet.
usage.empty: No usage recorded in this period.

containers.empty: No runners registered. Hosted runs need the shared runner pool or a runner per organization.
